'''Maal Lah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|Warrior]] and crèche-brother to [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]]. He served as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Biography==
Maal Lah was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] of the [[Warrior caste]]. A member of [[Domain Lah]] and crèche-brother to [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]], Maal Lah was [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of one of the fleets the Yuuzhan Vong sent during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. While he normally favored bold assaults, he had to tone down his attacks because of the forces present. With the successful conquest, Maal Lah was [[Escalation|escalated]] to [[Supreme Commander (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Supreme Commander]], and became one of Tsavong Lah's tactical advisors during the Battles of Borleias. After learning of [[Wyrpuuk Cha]]'s failure, Maal became convinced that [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] was the one who coordinated the battle. Maal Lah was later sent to [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]], where he had the difficult task of bringing the [[Peace Brigade]] forces into line. He was present during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Battle of Ylesia (28 ABY)|Raid on Ylesia]], where his leg was damaged beyond repair. He endured the pain and said the [[Shaper caste|Shapers]] would give him a new leg, if the [[Yun'o|gods]] favored him. However, he was crushed to [[Death/Legends|death]] by the falling rubble of a nearby building.

==Personality and traits==
Unlike other members of Domain Lah, Maal did not possess a single scar on his body, but instead chose to tattoo himself with blue and red swirls.
